declared_learning_outcomes_or_agenda: This course addresses the ethical considerations and responsibilities that must be taken into
account concerning artificial intelligence.  With appropriate ethics and responsibility, the objective
of this course is to equip students with the knowledge and guided skill set necessary to develop AI
for the benefit of society and technology consumers. In addition, the course underlines the
significance of comprehending the risk, impacts and threats posed by new developments in AI
technology, as well as the application of present regulations. Ethical issues in AI, AI governance, AI
system transformation, ethical risk assessment and management, ethical matrices, along with
societal and educational AI ethics will be among the subjects covered.
